narrative.overview: Every surface is a dark stone catching indigo light at its edges. Depth never comes from lifting things off the page — it comes from where the light lands: a gradient hairline on a card's top edge, the rim of the pill, the facet tracery of the gem-cut cat. The canvas breathes under a slow ambient aurora that drifts only while you're looking at it. Fraunces marks the moments; SF Pro does the work. The register is 'editorial Sunday, printed on black.'
keyCharacteristics: Committed dark: built dark, not themed dark (#0E0E16 canvas everywhere)
Depth by light: hairlines, rims, glows — not stacked drop shadows
Fraunces for moments, SF Pro for work, mono for the machine's own voice
Ambient life (aurora drift, cat blink, breathing glow) that pauses when unseen
One mascot, one accent family, one graphic secondary (amber)

rules.name: The Edge-Lit Rule
rules.body: Indigo light belongs on edges and in glows — hairlines, rims, tracery, eyes. If you're about to flood a large area with saturated indigo, stop; the surface stays onyx and the light stays on the edge.

rules.name: The Amber-Is-Graphic Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only as graphic accent (bars, waves, degraded-state marks). Text in amber territory uses Amber Ink or Ink.

rules.name: The Fraunces-Is-For-Moments Rule
rules.body: The serif appears on heroes, titles, day markers, and the wordmark — never on labels, buttons, data, or body copy.

rules.name: The Typography-Is-The-Icon Rule
rules.body: Where a concept has a voice, set its name in that voice instead of adding an icon: Verbatim in mono, gentlemanly in wonky Fraunces, super casual in lowercase rounded. Never emoji.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs more presence, give it light (hairline, glow, brighter edge) — not a bigger drop shadow.

dos: Do keep every surface on the committed dark canvas (#0E0E16) with panel cards (#1B1B26) — the app is built dark.
Do put indigo light on edges: hairlines, rims, tracery, glows.
Do push Fraunces to its display cut (opsz ≥ 96) and reserve it for moments.
Do gate every continuous animation on both Reduce Motion and actual window visibility (AmbientGate).
Do use typography as the icon where a concept has a voice; mono for what the machine hears or says verbatim.
Do keep the mascot singular: at most one Onyx Cat per surface.
donts: Don't build the SaaS analytics dashboard — dense metric grids, gradient hero numbers, card-on-card layouts.
Don't ship cloud-AI product theater — sparkle icons, AI-magic gradient copy, chat-bubble skeuomorphism.
Don't add noisy utility chrome — spinners, aggressive toasts, neon status dots, a pill that shouts.
Don't transplant the generic modern-SaaS indigo template — rounded-everything drop-shadow cards on white.
Don't use emoji as iconography anywhere in product UI.
Don't nest cards, stack drop shadows for depth, or use gradient text.
Don't flood large areas with saturated indigo or set body text in amber.
Don't leave a TimelineView reachable in a hidden window — every hide path must land in a state that renders no timeline.
